Malignant neoplasm of the iris.

Allergen-mediated inflammation of the middle ear.
Immune-mediated inflammation of blood vessels; additional organ damage varies across vasculitis subtypes.
Hereditary longitudinal mediosternal skin hypopigmentation.

Inherited calcium pyrophosphate deposition disorder affecting articular cartilage and causing degenerative arthropathy.

Peripheral motor-sensory axonal and demyelinating neuropathy; distal muscle wasting and weakness reflect denervation.
Hearing loss ~60%; cleft palate and airway obstruction common; eyelid defects omitted by cap. [NIH](https://medlineplus.gov/genetics/condition/nager-syndrome/).
Melanoma originating in the ocular ciliary body.
Primary arterial hypertension; hypertensive kidney disease, retinopathy and stroke are separately diagnosed complications.
Subcutaneous filarial infection; conjunctival migration and Calabar swellings are transient. Encephalopathy described here is treatment-associated.
Auditory canal malformations with hearing loss in 6/6; persistent eyelid ptosis occurs in 3/4. Microphthalmos alone is below threshold at 1/4.
